notes: Checked all validator overlap pairs against the printed source tables on PDF pages 59–68. The overlaps are present in the manual itself, including Profibus[35] Item at 40121 against Profibus[12] Item scale value at 40120 (pp. 59–60), Profibus[91] Item at 40437 against its Item scale value at 40436 (p. 62), Profibus[140] Item at 40461 against Profibus[97] Item scale value at 40460 (pp. 63–64), and Profibus entries overlapping IO/comparator entries (pp. 65–68). Addresses are retained as printed because the document does not provide enough evidence to choose corrected addresses.
